name: St. Mary's Cathedral, Galle (RC Diocese)
description: St. Mary's Cathedral, Galle (RC Diocese) stands as a testament to the rich Christian heritage of Galle. Built in the 17th century, this cathedral is a stunning example of Dutch colonial architecture, featuring intricate carvings and a serene interior that draws visitors from around the world.
activities: Explore the cathedral, learn about its history, take photos

name: St. Joseph's Chapel, Galle Fort
description: St. Joseph's Chapel, nestled within the historic Galle Fort, stands as a testament to the Catholic community's devotion. This charming chapel, adorned with intricate carvings and historical significance, offers visitors a glimpse into the rich cultural tapestry of Galle.
activities: Explore the chapel's interior and exterior, Learn about Galle's history, Take photos of the fort and the chapel

name: Wathuruwila Aranya Senasanaya (forest monastery)
description: Discover Wathuruwila Aranya Senasanaya, a serene Buddhist forest monastery nestled amidst lush greenery and ancient trees. This tranquil retreat offers a perfect escape from the hustle of daily life, where visitors can immerse themselves in nature and meditation.
activities: Meditation Practice, Nature Walks, Bird Watching
